remarks: Nestled in the heart of Norwalk, this beautifully maintained Colonial blends timeless New England charm with modern updates. From the moment you step into the grand entry foyer, you're greeted by a striking staircase & the warmth of a home designed for both comfort & style. The spacious living room, with an inviting open-hearth fireplace, is perfect for cozy evenings or lively gatherings. A versatile home office or guest room opens to the stunning backyard, the ideal space for work or relaxation. The kitchen features new GE Profile stainless steel appliances & granite countertops. The main level also includes a large dining room & half bath, all accented by natural light reflecting off hardwood floors. Upstairs, you'll find 3 generous bedrooms, including a primary suite with ample closet space & potential for future expansion into a luxurious en suite. A spacious landing connects to full bath, complete with tub & convenient washer/dryer. The finished lower level has flexibility with room for gym, playroom, or bedroom. Generous storage options in the basement, garage, & outdoor shed. Step outside to your private & large fenced backyard oasis, featuring a composite deck & lush, mature gardens. It's the perfect setting for entertaining, gardening, or simply unwinding in your own serene retreat. Located in prime Norwalk neighborhood, this home has easy access to shopping & dining with short drive to East Norwalk, SONO & Westport train stations for easy commuting
